title: Quest Line 01 — The Krampus Conspiracy
premise: The player arrives in Hollyhollow during its annual Winterwake Festival. Wild Pokémon have turned aggressive, Pokémon are disappearing, and strange black-and-red markings appear on trees and rocks. A mysterious group in dark crimson uniforms — Team Krampus — is behind it all. Their motto: "The world has forgotten what fear is."

chapters.name: Chapter I — Strange Beginnings
chapters.description: The Winterwake Festival, aggressive Pokémon, and the first black-and-red markings. Someone is working in the pines.

chapters.name: Chapter II — The Relic and the Lieutenant
chapters.description: The shrine, the Winterheart, and the first named member of Team Krampus.

chapters.name: Chapter III — The Blackout
chapters.description: Hollyhollow goes dark. Team Krampus strikes the town — and takes the bell.

chapters.name: Chapter IV — The Krampus Keep
chapters.description: The frozen fortress, the truth beneath the mask, and the first bell.
